paper.title: Zeolite-Templated Carbon Materials for High-Pressure Hydrogen Storage

defaults.verified_by: Agent B (sonnet, independent re-derivation of Table 1 + methods): 10 rows, 0 disputes. BET (1095/3244/1691/2964/3591), the 77 K Gibbs-excess maxima and the 298 K/30 MPa high-P uptakes, and skeletal densities all confirmed against Table 1 ('from this study' values used, literature rows excluded). uptake_type=excess ('Gibbs's excess') and uptake_bound (exact at 77 K; approximate for the extrapolated 30 MPa values) confirmed. pressure_unstated correct on the four 77 K maxima with no stated peak pressure (only ZTC-3 states 2.4 MPa/24 bar). Calibration point earned by hand (He-pycnometry skeletal-density void correction + empty-holder background subtraction on both apparatus; commercial-standard verification); all 10 tiers reproduced exactly (M1-M10 = B,A,B,B,B,A,A,A,A,A). The 5 room-temperature rows admitted at 300 bar flagged under manual S11.4. No changes.

notes.type: uptake_type=excess (exact-word rule): the paper reports 'Gibbs's excess uptake' throughout and Table 1 is excess capacity
notes.mmol: uptake recorded as uptake_mmol_g (the paper's unit); uptake_wt_pct is filled only where the paper prints it (ZTC-3: 5.5 wt% at 77 K, 1.6 wt% at 298 K) to avoid a basis conversion
notes.max77: the 77 K value is the Gibbs surface-excess MAXIMUM, reached between 1 and 4 MPa; only ZTC-3's maximum pressure is stated (2.4 MPa = 24 bar), so the other four 77 K rows carry pressure_unstated
notes.p298: the 298 K value is the excess uptake at 30 MPa (=300 bar), calculated by extrapolation of the measured 0-30 MPa isotherm to 30 MPa; uptake_bound=approximate, and >200 bar is admitted flagged (manual S11.4)
notes.method: H2 excess by custom volumetric Sieverts apparatus (77 K to 10 MPa, 298 K to 70 MPa); background subtracted with an empty-holder run; sample true volume from He-pycnometry skeletal density -> He void-volume correction -> calibration point by hand (tiering doc)
notes.ztc: zeolite-templated carbon: furfuryl-alcohol impregnation of zeolite (NaY or NHbeta), propylene CVD at 700 C, carbonization 900 C, HF dissolution of the template; class=templated_carbon, synthesis_method=template_synthesis (HYC-0042/0045)
notes.ref: commercial reference carbon measured in this study (not a literature value): class=activated_carbon, synthesis_method=commercial
notes.excl: the Table 1 literature rows (CNS-201, MSC-30, MSC-30, P7(2)-H from refs 5 and 16) are other papers' values and are excluded; DR micropore volumes are in the unavailable SI
notes.bet: surface_area_method=BET, calculated to 'point B' with a per-material P/P0 range; skeletal_density by He pycnometry (Table 1)

S1.label: CNS-201
S1.material_description: commercial activated carbon CNS-201 (A.C. Carbons Canada), measured in this study

S2.label: MSC-30
S2.material_description: commercial superactivated carbon Maxsorb MSC-30 (Kansai Coke), measured in this study

S3.label: ZTC-1
S3.material_description: zeolite-templated carbon from zeolite NHbeta (furfuryl alcohol + propylene CVD, 900 C, HF)
S3.purification_method: HF dissolution of the zeolite template, repeated until no zeolite XRD peak remained

S4.label: ZTC-2
S4.material_description: zeolite-templated carbon from zeolite NaY (furfuryl alcohol + propylene CVD, 900 C, HF)
S4.purification_method: HF dissolution of the zeolite template, repeated until no zeolite XRD peak remained

S5.label: ZTC-3
S5.material_description: high-fidelity zeolite-templated carbon from zeolite NaY (improved inert handling; furfuryl alcohol + propylene CVD, 900 C, HF)
S5.purification_method: HF dissolution of the zeolite template, repeated until no zeolite XRD peak remained
